Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 5, 2026

What the prototype processes

Live camera and microphone streams are processed in the browser for the demonstration. The prototype does not upload camera frames or microphone audio to a QuietPaws server for inference.

Local session data

Demo/session entries are stored in your browser's local storage. You can clear them using your browser controls or by clearing site data.

Analytics

Vercel Web Analytics may be enabled for the public website. If enabled, it is used for aggregate website usage and is separate from the camera/microphone inference loop. QuietPaws does not use analytics to process the live camera or microphone stream.

Permissions

Live mode requires browser permission for camera and microphone. You can deny those permissions and still use the controlled demo.

Contact

This is a hackathon prototype. Replace this section with your official contact address before production release.
